modifiers.name: Artillery
modifiers.englishText: Scene Modifier; Deploy alongside the Scene. After Deployment, choose one shape: two infinite Lines with no adjacent spaces between them, a 3 × 3 Zone, a 2 × 5 Zone, or every edge space. Indicate that shape anywhere on the board. At each Round's end, deal [Tension] damage to all opponents in the indicated spaces, then indicate a new area of the chosen shape.

source.pdfPath: source/original/DAWN_ The RPG (LionWing Edition) w Bookmarks.pdf

modifiers.name: Blaze
modifiers.englishText: NPC Modifier; Attach instead of Deploying. Gives 2 Speed. When the Host rolls its primary Attack and scores at least [Tier / 2] Critical Hits, it Blazes. Choose one effect for this Modifier: Burn deals [Tier] additional damage and pushes the target 1 space; Freeze Slows the target, or Immobilizes it if already Slowed; Accelerate Hastens and Strengthens the Host; Toughen Reinforces and Strengthens the Host.

source.pdfPath: source/original/DAWN_ The RPG (LionWing Edition) w Bookmarks.pdf

modifiers.name: Collateral
modifiers.englishText: Scene Modifier; Deploy alongside the Scene. Place friendly NPCs equal to 1.5 times the number of player characters in empty spaces. Each has 5 + [Tier] Health and cannot take Turns. Create a Peril Clock with one Segment per player character; fill a Segment when one of these NPCs is Knocked Out, and the players lose the combat when it fills. Enemies may target one as a player only if it is not adjacent to a non-VIP player or player-owned Summon, and otherwise cannot harm it. A player may remove one safely by Interacting and passing a 1 + [Tier] Spirit challenge Roll.

source.pdfPath: source/original/DAWN_ The RPG (LionWing Edition) w Bookmarks.pdf

modifiers.name: Contagion
modifiers.englishText: NPC Modifier; Attach instead of Deploying. Gives 5 + [Tier × 5] Evasion. When Attached, indicate a player character. At each Round's end, deal [Tension] damage to all opponents within 3 spaces of that character, excluding the indicated character, then indicate a new player character.

source.pdfPath: source/original/DAWN_ The RPG (LionWing Edition) w Bookmarks.pdf

modifiers.name: Earthquake
modifiers.englishText: NPC Modifier; Attach instead of Deploying. Gives 5 + [Tier × 5] Evasion. When Attached, indicate In or Out. At each Round's end, deal [Tension] damage to all opponents farther than 2 spaces from the Host if In is indicated, or within 2 spaces if Out is indicated, then switch to the other option.

source.pdfPath: source/original/DAWN_ The RPG (LionWing Edition) w Bookmarks.pdf

modifiers.name: Gargantuan
modifiers.englishText: NPC Modifier; Attach instead of Deploying. Gives [Tier] Armor and 5 + [Tier × 5] Evasion. All connected Parts have 0 Speed and cannot move. On Attachment, expand one edge of the board by one space to 7 × 8; this NPC occupies every added space. Its Host gains an Attack: target up to two 2 × 2 Zones anywhere, remove Terrain previously created by this Attack, destroy Terrain there, push all characters out, and place Terrain in those spaces. Targeting that Terrain targets this NPC instead, and this NPC and its Parts may draw range from it. Roll 4 + [Tier]. Reward: deal [Hits] + [Tension] damage to characters moved by the Attack.

source.pdfPath: source/original/DAWN_ The RPG (LionWing Edition) w Bookmarks.pdf

modifiers.name: Giant
modifiers.englishText: NPC Modifier; Attach instead of Deploying. Gives [Tier] Armor and 1 Speed. The Host occupies a 2 × 2 area and gains an Attack: move up to 4 spaces in a straight Line, ignoring opponents. Push each opponent moved through into an unoccupied space adjacent to the Host's new location and Launch them.

source.pdfPath: source/original/DAWN_ The RPG (LionWing Edition) w Bookmarks.pdf

modifiers.name: Haven
modifiers.englishText: Scene Modifier; Deploy alongside the Scene. On Deployment, indicate a 3 × 3 Zone. At each Round's end, deal [Tension] damage to all opponents outside the indicated Zone, then move the Zone anywhere on the board.

source.pdfPath: source/original/DAWN_ The RPG (LionWing Edition) w Bookmarks.pdf

modifiers.name: Isolation
modifiers.englishText: Scene Modifier; Deploy alongside the Scene. When Attached, indicate a player character. At each Round's end, deal 2 + [Tier] damage multiplied by the number of player characters to all players within 3 spaces of the indicated character, excluding that character; divide this damage by the number of players receiving it. Then indicate another player.

source.pdfPath: source/original/DAWN_ The RPG (LionWing Edition) w Bookmarks.pdf

modifiers.name: Legion
modifiers.englishText: Scene Modifier; Deploy alongside the Scene. On Deployment, create a Legion Clock with Segments equal to the number of Deployed players plus [Tier]. Fill one Segment whenever a non-Fodder enemy is Knocked Out; when full, Knock Out all enemies and end combat. At each Round's start, return up to [Tension] Knocked-Out non-Compound enemies at half Health to board-edge spaces. If fewer can return, create edge Fodder Zones equal to the difference.

source.pdfPath: source/original/DAWN_ The RPG (LionWing Edition) w Bookmarks.pdf

modifiers.name: VIP
modifiers.englishText: Scene Modifier; Deploy alongside the Scene. Place one friendly NPC with 15 + [Tier] Health in an empty space; it cannot take Turns. Once per Turn when an ally leaves its adjacency, they may move it to their new position. If it is Knocked Out, all players are Knocked Out. Enemies may target it as a player Summon only if it is not adjacent to a non-VIP player or player-owned Summon, and otherwise cannot harm it.

source.pdfPath: source/original/DAWN_ The RPG (LionWing Edition) w Bookmarks.pdf

modifiers.name: Vortex
modifiers.englishText: NPC Modifier; Attach instead of Deploying. Gives 1 + [Tier] Armor. At each Round's end after Attachment, create 5 Fodder Zones spread across the board edge or edges farthest from the Host. These Zones may move only closer to the Host. When one touches the Host, Knock it Out and give the Host 1 Armor for the rest of the Scene. When this effect has increased its Armor by 3, deal 20 + [Tier × 2] damage to all players.

antagonists.name: All-Seeing
antagonists.englishText: Predictable (Defense Reaction): gain [Tier × 2] Evasion when Attacked; on a miss, move up to 3 spaces. Piercing Vision (Misc Reaction): when at least 4 spaces from an Attacked player, Mark them before the roll. Phase Change: spend 2 Antagonism, give all players 1 Influence, Deploy 2 equal-Tier Artillery NPCs, and restore [Tier × 5] Health.

source.pdfPath: source/original/DAWN_ The RPG (LionWing Edition) w Bookmarks.pdf

antagonists.name: Back-Stabbing
antagonists.englishText: Honorable Sacrifice (Defense Reaction): when any NPC is Attacked, teleport an ally adjacent and make it the target. Shirk the Blame (Turn Start): if another NPC is adjacent to a player, have it Taunt them. Phase Change: spend 2 Antagonism, give all players 1 Influence, Deploy 2 equal-Tier Bodyguards, restore [Tier × 5] Health, and gain [Tier × 3] Evasion.

source.pdfPath: source/original/DAWN_ The RPG (LionWing Edition) w Bookmarks.pdf

antagonists.name: Cruel-Hearted
antagonists.englishText: Body of Thorns (Defense Reaction): gain [Tier × 2] Armor when Attacked; if damage falls to 1, Blight the attacker. Sadist (Turn Start): clear Blight from any number of characters, Strengthen this NPC, and deal [Tier × 2] damage to each affected character. Phase Change: spend 2 Antagonism, give all players 1 Influence, attach equal-Tier Contagion and Isolation Modifiers, and restore [Tier × 5] Health.

source.pdfPath: source/original/DAWN_ The RPG (LionWing Edition) w Bookmarks.pdf

antagonists.name: God-Like
antagonists.englishText: BREAK (Defense Reaction): gain [Tier × 2] Armor when Attacked; if damage falls to 1, push the attacker 3 spaces and Slow them. BEHOLD (Turn Start): pull a non-adjacent player 2 spaces; Daze them if they become adjacent. Phase Change: spend 2 Antagonism, give all players 1 Influence, Deploy 2 equal-Tier Paladins, and restore [Tier × 5] Health.

source.pdfPath: source/original/DAWN_ The RPG (LionWing Edition) w Bookmarks.pdf

antagonists.name: Iron-Willed
antagonists.englishText: Guardian (Defense Reaction): when any NPC is Attacked, teleport adjacent to the attacker, gain [Tier × 2] Armor, and become the target. Jabbing Insults (Turn Start): Taunt an adjacent player. Phase Change: spend 2 Antagonism, give all players 1 Influence, Deploy 2 equal-Tier Swarms, restore [Tier × 5] Health, and gain [Tier] Armor.

source.pdfPath: source/original/DAWN_ The RPG (LionWing Edition) w Bookmarks.pdf

antagonists.name: Over-Confident
antagonists.englishText: Go On and Try (Defense Reaction): Mark yourself when Attacked to gain [Tier × 2] Evasion after the Attack. Drop the Weight (Turn Start): lose any Evasion to move 4 spaces through characters; each opponent crossed takes damage equal to the Evasion spent. Phase Change: spend 2 Antagonism, give all players 1 Influence, clear all negative Effects, become immune to them for the Scene, and restore [Tier × 5] Health.

source.pdfPath: source/original/DAWN_ The RPG (LionWing Edition) w Bookmarks.pdf

antagonists.name: Swift-Stepping
antagonists.englishText: Enter Shadow (Defense Reaction): gain [Tier × 2] Evasion when Attacked; on a miss, Teleport to the board edge and Disappear. Dominate (Turn Start): choose someone not Attacked since this NPC's last Turn and Mark them for Death; Attacks against them deal [Tier × 2] extra damage and remove it. Phase Change: spend 2 Antagonism, give all players 1 Influence, Disappear, Strengthen, restore [Tier × 5] Health, and gain [Tier × 3] Evasion.

source.pdfPath: source/original/DAWN_ The RPG (LionWing Edition) w Bookmarks.pdf

antagonists.name: Wild-Eyed
antagonists.englishText: Vicious Interception (Defense Reaction): Clash with the attacker as a player would. Beastly Roar (Turn Start): clear all Effects on this NPC, Daze opponents within 3 spaces, and push them to the nearest space 4 spaces away. Phase Change: spend 2 Antagonism, give all players 1 Influence, attach equal-Tier Giant and Earthquake Modifiers, and restore [Tier × 5] Health.

source.pdfPath: source/original/DAWN_ The RPG (LionWing Edition) w Bookmarks.pdf

antagonists.name: World-Renowned
antagonists.englishText: Hero's Interception (Defense Reaction): when any NPC is Attacked, Clash with the attacker as a player would. Inspiring Presence (Ally Turn Start): when another NPC starts its Turn, have it Attack or move one additional time. Phase Change: spend 2 Antagonism, give all players 1 Influence, force a player into a Duel, restore [Tier × 5] Health, and gain [Tier × 3] Evasion.

source.pdfPath: source/original/DAWN_ The RPG (LionWing Edition) w Bookmarks.pdf

antagonists.name: Foil
antagonists.englishText: Cost: 1 Antagonism. When a player's reward would directly prevent or hinder an Antagonist's action, give that player 1 Influence and delay the reward behind a 4-segment Clock that lasts until the end of the Scene. The reward occurs if the players fill the Clock.

source.pdfPath: source/original/DAWN_ The RPG (LionWing Edition) w Bookmarks.pdf

antagonists.name: Bargain
antagonists.englishText: Cost: 1 Antagonism. When a player would receive a reward affecting an Antagonist, present an additional Threat that will affect that player if they accept it. They may give up the reward and gain 1 Influence, or take the reward and the Threat.

source.pdfPath: source/original/DAWN_ The RPG (LionWing Edition) w Bookmarks.pdf

antagonists.name: All Out
antagonists.englishText: Cost: 1 Antagonism. In structured combat, reroll an enemy's Roll; it produces Hits on 3 or higher. The Roll's targets gain 1 Influence.

source.pdfPath: source/original/DAWN_ The RPG (LionWing Edition) w Bookmarks.pdf

antagonists.name: Break Out
antagonists.englishText: Cost: 1 Antagonism. In structured combat, have an enemy move or Attack outside the normal Turn order. Any player who is Attacked gains 1 Influence.

source.pdfPath: source/original/DAWN_ The RPG (LionWing Edition) w Bookmarks.pdf

antagonists.name: Escape
antagonists.englishText: Cost: 1 Antagonism. In any mode, an NPC leaves the Scene with one of the following: a new plan, a permanent injury, or a new power.

source.pdfPath: source/original/DAWN_ The RPG (LionWing Edition) w Bookmarks.pdf

antagonists.name: Awaken
antagonists.englishText: Cost: 1 Antagonism. Reveal a previously unknown plan or element of an Antagonist. An Antagonist may use this only once per Series; after doing so, they gain [Tier × 2] Antagonism.

source.pdfPath: source/original/DAWN_ The RPG (LionWing Edition) w Bookmarks.pdf

antagonists.name: Duel
antagonists.englishText: Cost: 1 Antagonism. Instead of an Attack on their Turn in combat, or at any time in unstructured play, an Antagonist forces an adjacent player character into a Duel and has [Tier] additional Advantage in it.

source.pdfPath: source/original/DAWN_ The RPG (LionWing Edition) w Bookmarks.pdf

antagonists.name: Hate
antagonists.englishText: Requires an Enemy Bond and permission for player-to-player use. When the user decides they will no longer stand for their Enemy, gain [Tier] Advantage on the current Roll. If the Enemy Bond is Rank 2 or higher, this also provides 1 Influence.

source.pdfPath: source/original/DAWN_ The RPG (LionWing Edition) w Bookmarks.pdf

antagonists.name: Abandon
antagonists.englishText: Requires permission for player-to-player use. When the user's perception of their Bond changes, remove that Bond and give the user Influence equal to its Rank. A player character can gain Influence by Abandoning a given character only once.
